'''Lvl-7 Enchant''' is a [[utility spell]] in the [[standard spellbook]], requiring level 93 [[Magic]] to cast. The spell enchants [[zenyte]] [[jewellery]], granting 110 Magic experience when doing so.

Unlike other enchanting spells, this spell does not have a [[magic tablet]] equivalent that can be made.
